subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “An old factory in the town used to sound a siren at noon.”?
options: Workers heard it and went to lunch.
Ella felt terrible when she heard this.
One class went to the wrong place.
Others went because it was peaceful.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Workers heard it and went to lunch.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Ella felt terrible when she heard this.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One class went to the wrong place.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Others went because it was peaceful.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Workers heard it and went to lunch.」，答案為「Workers heard it and went to lunch.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Workers heard it and went to lunch.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
